enovas $ENVA loan book is up 31.1% to 5.9 billion 
 
enova is an online lender to consumers and small businesses, so how much it holds in loans is the business itself. originations, the new loans it writes each quarter, are growing at a similar pace 
 
the net charge-off ratio, the share of loans written off as losses, is lower than a year ago, so the growth did not come with more losses

bread financial $BFH is the card company behind the store cards you get offered at the checkout 
 
it issues and runs credit cards for about 100 brand partners, names like ulta, signet and dell. the card networks hold the leverage over it, but the stores it serves mostly dont 
 
to me that looks like a lender with the upper hand over its retail partners, not a middleman at their mercy
